source_scope: Post-hoc rescoring of existing simulated CH11/CH16 responses; frozen cases, gold, answers and historical aggregates are read-only.

revision_basis.basis: CH16 observed citations after terminal punctuation being detached from the claim they annotate.
Observed deterministic false negatives for half-year/six-month and one-year/twelve-month expressions.
Observed policy answers using calculated settlement dates or signed-day counts that deterministic date rules misclassified.
Character 4-gram overlap was not semantic support; unresolved paraphrase is now uncertain rather than supported.

DEV-MULTI-02.basis: The question already supplies the 299 yuan order amount and asks whether shipping is free; only the threshold is a necessary answer fact.

DEV-MULTI-03.basis: The named SKU identifies the product; the question asks who pays return shipping, so repeating its product type is background.

DEV-MULTI-04.basis: The user states the order was signed and asks for the applicable return window; the window and date rule are the necessary facts.

DEV-MULTI-08.basis: The question asks how long after approval to send the item back; the 24-hour review time belongs to the prior stage.

DEV-MULTI-11.basis: The question asks whether a gold member receives the discount for a named product; growth threshold and price are context, not answer requirements.

DEV-SINGLE-04.basis: Data cable is an accessory; the answer states the concrete product and a six-month warranty.

DEV-CONSTRAINT-06.basis: The user supplies the 10 yuan expedited fee and asks whether it participates in the discount; only the participation rule is necessary.

DEV-CONSTRAINT-07.basis: The user supplies the 5 yuan surcharge and asks whether it counts toward a promotion threshold.

DEV-CONSTRAINT-08.basis: The user states the goods are intact; the answer need only resolve who pays the return shipping.

DEV-CONFLICT-05.basis: The question asks for the return window for a signed order; repeating the status is not required.

FRZ-MULTI-04.basis: The question asks what happens next for a return already in progress; the observed answer correctly explains warehouse inspection. The send-back deadline belongs to the earlier post-approval stage and is not required by this state.

FRZ-MULTI-05.basis: The question supplies the receipt date and asks for the policy window; the order status is background.

FRZ-MULTI-07.basis: The user states the order has not shipped and asks whether cancellation is allowed.

FRZ-MULTI-08.basis: The user states the order is refunded and asks for the refund channel.

FRZ-MULTI-10.basis: The question only asks the expedited-shipping surcharge; the product price is background context and is not a necessary answer fact.

FRZ-MULTI-15.basis: The user states the order is cancelled and asks whether money returns and when.

FRZ-CONSTRAINT-11.basis: The user states the goods are intact; the answer need only resolve the non-quality return payer.

FRZ-CONSTRAINT-12.basis: The question asks who pays return shipping after quality-return approval; the separate seven-day send-back deadline is background.

FRZ-ENTITY-01.basis: The answer omits the contextually redundant word wireless but identifies the correct in-ear form factor.
